title: Cookie Policy
intro: This Cookie Policy explains how ItalBridge Partners uses cookies and similar technologies, and how you can control your preferences.

sections.title: What Are Cookies
sections.text: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They allow the site to remember your actions and preferences over a period of time. ItalBridge Partners uses cookies to operate the website and, with your consent, to understand how the site is used.

sections.title: Types of Cookies We Use
sections.text: Necessary cookies: required for the website to function correctly, including remembering your cookie consent preferences. These cannot be disabled. Analytics cookies: used only with your consent, to collect anonymous information about how visitors use the site so we can improve it.

sections.title: Consent
sections.text: When you first visit our website, you will see a cookie consent banner. You may accept all cookies, reject non-necessary cookies, or manage your preferences. Your choice is logged with a timestamp and stored locally. You can change your preferences at any time using the Cookie Settings link in the footer.

sections.title: Consent Logging
sections.text: We record your consent decision — including the categories of cookies accepted and the date and time of your choice — to demonstrate compliance with the Kenya Data Protection Act and the GDPR requirement for demonstrable consent.

sections.title: Third-Party Cookies
sections.text: We do not use third-party advertising or tracking cookies. Analytics, where enabled, uses privacy-respecting tools that do not identify individual users.

sections.title: Managing Cookies in Your Browser
sections.text: In addition to our consent manager, you can control or delete cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling all cookies may affect the functionality of the website.

sections.title: Updates
sections.text: We may update this Cookie Policy as our use of cookies changes. Material changes will be reflected in the “Last Updated” date above.
